counterfactual_missing_items: absence of S100 positivity in pagetoid cells
absence of HMB-45 positivity in pagetoid cells
decisive_items: intraepidermal neoplasm consisting of pagetoid cells
response.rationale: The presence of intraepidermal pagetoid cells with CK7 and EMA positivity is diagnostic of Extramammary Paget's Disease, ruling out melanoma which would show S100 and HMB-45 positivity in tumor cells.
